defs.d: A map.
A systematic non-narrative presentation of data.
To draw a chart or map of.
To draw or figure out (a route or plan).
defs.ex: Let's chart how we're going to get from here to there.

defs.d: Someone or something that is large in stature
An important or powerful person; a celebrity; a big name.
To praise, recommend, or promote.
Of great size, large.
defs.ex: Elephants are big animals, and they eat a lot.

defs.d: (of an industry or other field, often capitalized) Thought to have undue influence.
defs.ex: Big Tech

defs.d: A common, round fruit produced by the tree Malus domestica, cultivated in temperate climates.

Any of various tree-borne fruits or vegetables especially considered as resembling an apple; also (with qualifying words) used to form the names of other specific fruits such as custard apple, rose apple, thorn apple etc.
To become apple-like.
To form buds.
Free from error; true; accurate.
With good manners; well behaved; conforming with accepted standards of behaviour.
A patron, a client; one who purchases or receives a product or service from a business or merchant, or intends to do so.
defs.ex: Every person who passes by is a potential customer.

defs.d: A person, especially one engaging in some sort of interaction with others.
defs.ex: a cool customer, a tough customer, an ugly customer

defs.d: The act of learning something
To acquire, or attempt to acquire knowledge or an ability to do something.
To attend a course or other educational activity.
The aggregate of past events.
defs.ex: History repeats itself if we don’t learn from its mistakes.

defs.d: The branch of knowledge that studies the past; the assessment of notable events.
defs.ex: He teaches history at the university.   History will not look kindly on these tyrants.   He dreams of an invention that will make history.

defs.d: To narrate or record.
A big cat, Panthera leo, native to Africa, India and formerly much of Europe.
defs.ex: Tigers and lions share a common ancestor from a few million years ago.

defs.d: (by extension) Any of various extant and extinct big cats, especially the mountain lion.
Of the light brown color that resembles the fur of a lion.
Not closed
Not physically drawn together, closed, folded or contracted; extended
defs.ex: an open hand; an open flower

defs.d: A legless reptile of the sub-order Serpentes with a long, thin body and a fork-shaped tongue.
A treacherous person.
To follow or move in a winding route.
defs.ex: The path snaked through the forest.

defs.d: To steal slyly.
defs.ex: He snaked my DVD!

defs.d: The common minnow, Phoxinus phoxinus.
A young Atlantic salmon, Salmo salar, before it becomes a smolt; a parr.
A two-dimensional geometric figure, a line, consisting of the set of all those points in a plane that are equally distant from a given point (center).
defs.ex: The set of all points (x, y) such that (x − 1)2 + y2 = r2 is a circle of radius r around the point (1, 0).

defs.d: A two-dimensional geometric figure, a disk, consisting of the set of all those points of a plane at a distance less than or equal to a fixed distance (radius) from a given point.
To travel around along a curved path.
defs.ex: The wolves circled the herd of deer.

defs.d: To surround.
defs.ex: A high fence circles the enclosure.

defs.d: The time at which something happens.
defs.ex: A good article will cover the who, the what, the when, the where, the why and the how.

defs.d: (interrogative) At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.
defs.ex: Do you know when they arrived?

defs.d: At an earlier time and under different, usually less favorable, circumstances.
defs.ex: He's mister high and mighty now, but I remember him when.

defs.d: (interrogative) What time; which time.
defs.ex: Since when do I need your permission?

defs.d: The time that.
defs.ex: I recall when they were called the Greys.

defs.d: A pronged tool having a long straight handle, used for digging, lifting, throwing etc.
A pronged tool for use in the garden; a smaller hand fork for weeding etc., or larger for turning over the soil.
To divide into two or more branches.
defs.ex: A road, a tree, or a stream forks.

defs.d: To move with a fork (as hay or food).
To have sexual intercourse, to copulate.
defs.ex: Fighting for peace is like fucking for virginity.

defs.d: To have sexual intercourse with.
To contend in physical conflict, either singly or in war, battle etc.
defs.ex: A wounded animal will fight like a maniac, relentless, savage and murderous.

defs.d: To contend in physical conflict with each other, either singly or in war, battle etc.
defs.ex: The two boxers have been fighting for more than half an hour.

defs.d: Someone entrusted with a secret; a confidant.
A person who keeps records, takes notes and handles general clerical work.
To serve as a secretary of.
From a specified time in the past.
defs.ex: A short/long time since

defs.d: From: referring to a period of time ending in the present and defining it by the point in time at which it started, or the period in which its starting point occurred.
From the time that.
defs.ex: I have loved you since I first met you.

defs.d: Because.
defs.ex: Since you didn't call, we left without you.

defs.d: A character or part played by a performer or actor.
defs.ex: Her dream was to get a role in a Hollywood movie, no matter how small.

defs.d: The expected behaviour of an individual in a society.
defs.ex: The role of women has changed significantly in the last century.

defs.d: To be amazed at; to view with surprise; to marvel at.
To regard with wonder and delight.
Oriented toward the back.
defs.ex: The battleship had three backwards guns at the stern, in addition to the primary complement.

defs.d: Reversed.
defs.ex: The backwards lettering on emergency vehicles makes it possible to read in the rear-view mirror.

defs.d: The quality or condition of being important or worthy of note.
Significance or prominence.
In a heavy manner.
defs.ex: He clomped heavily up the stairs in his boots.

defs.d: With a great weight.
defs.ex: heavily burdened

defs.d: To be or become mad.
To madden, to anger, to frustrate.
Insane; crazy, mentally deranged.
defs.ex: He's got this mad idea that he's irresistible to women.

defs.d: (chiefly US; informal in UK) Angry, annoyed.
defs.ex: Are you mad at me?

defs.d: Intensifier; to a large degree; extremely; exceedingly; very; unbelievably.
defs.ex: He seems mad keen on her.

defs.d: The act of performing; carrying into execution or action; execution; achievement; accomplishment; representation by action.
defs.ex: the performance of an undertaking or a duty

defs.d: That which is performed or accomplished; a thing done or carried through; an achievement; a deed; an act; a feat; especially, an action of an elaborate or public character.
A prescribed quantity or extent.
The act or result of measuring.
To ascertain the quantity of a unit of material via calculated comparison with respect to a standard.
defs.ex: We measured the temperature with a thermometer.   You should measure the angle with a spirit level.

defs.d: To be of (a certain size), to have (a certain measurement)
defs.ex: The window measured two square feet.

defs.d: A species which reproduces by sexual rather than asexual reproduction, or a member of such a species.
A person who experiences sexual attraction, a person who has interest in or desire for sex (especially as contrasted with an asexual).
Arising from the fact of being male or female; pertaining to sex or gender, or to the social relations between the sexes.
defs.ex: Women face sexual discrimination in the workplace.

defs.d: Capable of sexual reproduction; sexed, sexuate.
Someone who views a spectacle; an onlooker or spectator.
Someone who watches television.
A woody plant distinguished from a tree by its multiple stems and lower height, being usually less than six metres tall; a horticultural rather than strictly botanical category.
A shrub cut off, or a shrublike branch of a tree.
defs.ex: bushes to support pea vines

defs.d: To branch thickly in the manner of a bush.
To set bushes for; to support with bushes.
defs.ex: to bush peas

defs.d: A forward move; improvement or progression.
defs.ex: an advance in health or knowledge

defs.d: An amount of money or credit, especially given as a loan, or paid before it is due; an advancement.
To promote or advantage.
To move forward in space or time.
Completed before necessary or a milestone event.
defs.ex: He made an advance payment on the prior shipment to show good faith.

defs.d: Preceding
defs.ex: The advance man came a month before the candidate.

defs.d: Molten material, the product of melting.
The transition of matter from a solid state to a liquid state.
To change (or to be changed) from a solid state to a liquid state, usually by a gradual heat.
defs.ex: I melted butter to make a cake.

defs.d: To dissolve, disperse, vanish.
defs.ex: His troubles melted away.

defs.d: The rate of occurrence of anything; the relationship between incidence and time period.
defs.ex: The frequency of bus service has been improved from one every 15 to one every 12 minutes.

defs.d: The property of occurring often rather than infrequently.
defs.ex: The FAQ addresses questions that come up with some frequency.

defs.d: A feeling of extreme happiness or cheerfulness, especially related to the acquisition or expectation of something good.
defs.ex: They will be a source of strength and joy in your life.

defs.d: Anything that causes such a feeling.
defs.ex: the joys and demands of parenthood

defs.d: To make a pledge to (someone); to promise, guarantee (someone of something); to assure.
To make sure or certain of something (usually some future event or condition).
defs.ex: I use an alarm clock to ensure that I get up on time.
